FEDERAL ELECTION COMMISSION


Sunshine Act Meetings

TIME AND DATE: Tuesday, October 21, 2025 at 10:30 a.m.

PLACE: 1050 First Street NE, Washington, DC and virtual (this meeting 
will be a hybrid meeting.)

STATUS: This meeting will be closed to the public.

MATTERS TO BE CONSIDERED: Matters concerning participation in civil 
actions or proceedings or arbitration.
    Additional Information: This meeting will be cancelled if the 
Commission is not open due to a funding lapse.

CONTACT PERSON FOR MORE INFORMATION: Myles Martin, Deputy Press 
Officer, Telephone: (202) 694-1221.

(Authority: Government in the Sunshine Act, 5 U.S.C. 552b)

Vicktoria J. Allen,
Deputy Secretary of the Commission.
[FR Doc. 2025-19190 Filed 9-29-25; 4:15 pm]
BILLING CODE 6715-01-P
